title: ASF™ Commit Gate — checklist entry
description: One verification the Commit Gate Agent performs. The checklist is configuration, not prompt: adding a verification is an administrative act, not a release. It is installation-wide policy, and every report carries the checklist version it was judged against.

id.description: Stable identifier, category.name — for example asf.linkage. Reports reference it, so it must not change once used.

applies_to.description: Scope. Without it a test verification fails on a commit that touches only a README, and a gate that cries wolf is ignored within a week.

layers.description: Project layers (D-8.24): repo names of project.repos or architecture.json components with a path.

expectation.description: What must be true, in one sentence. This is what the agent judges against.

how_to_verify.description: Where to look and what counts as evidence.

action_codes.description: Which catalogue codes this verification is allowed to emit. Constraining them here is what keeps a checklist entry dispatchable by the caller.

blocks_merge.description: Whether a failure of this entry contributes to a blocking verdict. The gate reports; enforcement belongs to the CI or MR rule.
